subject: One last question on prioritization after our demo
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@acme.com>
Cc: Karen Liu <karen.liu@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: One last question on prioritization after our demo

Thanks again for taking the time today, Jordan — great conversation. Quick recap and one small question on prioritization so we can shape next steps:

Short recap:
- Use case: reduce inference cost on customer-facing search reranking and speed up 95th percentile latency for chat features across web and mobile.
- Primary constraint: procurement window opens mid-June; security review expected (SOC 2 paperwork).
- Technical ask: proof-of-concept on a subset of queries (3–5 endpoints) for 2 weeks, plus an SLA target for p95 latency below 250ms.

Action items we agreed:
1) I’ll share the demo notes and a draft SOW for a micro-pilot (attached).
2) You’ll confirm which three endpoints to test and an internal owner for the pilot.
3) If timing looks good, we’ll prepare Reserved Capacity recommendations and a budget estimate.

One last question for your team: how high is this project on your Q2 priorities?
- If it’s a top-three engineering priority, we can line up a pilot starting the week of May 24th.
- If it’s lower, we can shift to a later micro-commit cadence and keep things light (demo replay + sandbox access).

Would you share a quick signal (high / medium / low) and a preferred owner for the pilot? Even a one-line reply is perfect.

Attachments: 20270512-demo-notes.pdf (summary + tech checklist), acme-sow-draft-v1.docx (pilot SOW).

Thanks — happy to jump on a 15-min sync if that’s easier.

—
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
